knowledge.name: Synthetic requisitions and frameworks
knowledge.detail: Fictional requisitions from the maintenance plan, capital projects and stock model, with framework coverage.

knowledge.name: Supplier performance
knowledge.detail: Framework suppliers with on-time-in-full rate and open nonconformances used for the shortlist.

knowledge.name: RFQ pack, clarifications and bids
knowledge.detail: The published RFQ pack topics, clarifications sent to all bidders, and each bid's price, lead time and documents.

knowledge.name: Orders, shipping notices and invoices
knowledge.detail: Open purchase orders with acknowledgements and ASNs, and invoices with their PO and goods receipt.

intelligence_processing.name: Procurement route rules
intelligence_processing.detail: Chooses direct award, mini-competition, open tender or three quotes from framework coverage and value.

intelligence_processing.name: Shortlist eligibility
intelligence_processing.detail: Keeps framework suppliers at or above the on-time floor with no open major nonconformance.

intelligence_processing.name: Supplier question answering
intelligence_processing.detail: Answers from the published pack only; anything new becomes a clarification for every bidder.

intelligence_processing.name: Weighted bid scoring
intelligence_processing.detail: Scores price, lead time, quality and sustainability against the published weights and ranks the bids.

intelligence_processing.name: Delivery and three-way match checks
intelligence_processing.detail: Flags missing acknowledgements and late ASNs, and holds invoices that bill too many units or the wrong price.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio procurement assistant
clients_user_interface.detail: Hosts the pilot with five skills and two synthetic knowledge files; the package stays Draft until review.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat
clients_user_interface.detail: Runs the single-file ProcurementSupplierCollaborationAgent locally over the source-to-pay snapshot.

clients_user_interface.name: Power Apps supplier portal
clients_user_interface.detail: Where suppliers receive RFQs, ask questions, bid, acknowledge orders and submit shipping notices.

management_reporting.name: Sourcing plan
management_reporting.detail: Open requisitions with value, demand source, need-by date and recommended route.

management_reporting.name: Bid evaluation table
management_reporting.detail: Ranked bids with the score for each criterion and a narrative for the award panel.

management_reporting.name: Procurement acceptance evidence
management_reporting.detail: Five locked category manager, buyer, expediter and accounts payable cases, one per operation.

tools.name: Portable ProcurementSupplierCollaborationAgent
tools.detail: Single-file Python BasicAgent with five deterministic read-only operations over synthetic records.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the five-skill package; publishing stays with an authorized reviewer.

tools.name: Microsoft Dataverse and Power Automate
tools.detail: Cited read-only seam: Power Automate brings ERP requisitions, orders, receipts and invoices into Dataverse.

tools.name: Power Apps supplier portal
tools.detail: Carries RFQs, bids, clarifications, acknowledgements and shipping notices with authenticated suppliers.

tools.name: ERP finance module
tools.detail: Approves matched invoices for payment; only accounts payable acts there.

supporting_features.name: Synthetic utility evidence boundary
supporting_features.detail: Every requisition, supplier, bid, order, invoice and amount is invented.

supporting_features.name: No award, order, message or payment
supporting_features.detail: Never issues an RFQ, awards, orders, messages a supplier, posts a receipt or approves a payment.

supporting_features.name: Equal treatment of bidders
supporting_features.detail: Answers outside the published pack go to every bidder as a clarification, decided by the buyer.

supporting_features.name: Five routable operations
supporting_features.detail: Sourcing plan, supplier question, bid evaluation, delivery tracking and three-way match each answer one question.

supporting_features.name: Controlled future writes
supporting_features.detail: Any later write needs authenticated tools, authorization checks, explicit human approval, and an audit log.
